suggest.title: Suggest a Tool
suggest.description: Have an idea for a research or teaching tool?

research.title: GPU Gateway
research.description: Password-protected chat playground for the Simulating Open Democracy inference backend. Talks to a reverse proxy on the lab workstation over an encrypted tunnel; the password is checked server-side and never ships with the site.
features: Streaming chat against the local RTX GPU (OpenAI-compatible API)
Bearer-password auth verified by the proxy, not the browser
Endpoint and session-only password fields (nothing persisted server-side)
Works with any ngrok tunnel URL

research.title: CausalFlow
research.description: An interactive visual tool for specifying longitudinal causal models and exporting them to lavaan syntax for Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) analysis in R.
features: Drag-and-drop interface for building path diagrams

research.title: Markdown Diff
research.description: Compare two Markdown documents in the browser. Both are normalized first — line endings, whitespace, heading and list formatting — so formatting noise does not read as change.

research.title: Flow Editor
research.description: Browser-based diagram editor for process flows, research pipelines, and data models. Drag typed nodes onto a canvas, connect them, and export the result as an image.
features: Typed node palette, including research nodes (experiment, hypothesis, analysis)

teaching.title: QuizView
teaching.description: A Next.js web app that lets you preview and visualize Brightspace quiz CSV files before uploading them to your LMS.
features: Visual preview of questions and answers
